learning_outcomes.text: Expand knowledge gained from Hydro- or Thermodynamics subjects related to course of study project and Bachelor thesis topics.
Conduct background research in appropriate fields and define Bachelor thesis aims under supervision.
Present and discuss Bachelor thesis results.

syllabus_topics: Basic equations and laws of Fluid Mechanics and Thermodynamics and their application to basic problems.
Design of piping systems and pumps.
Basic functional principles and designs of pumps.
Basic structural arrangement, structural design of axial and radial fans.
Basic division, specifications and differences, model calculation of a reciprocating internal combustion engine.
Approaches based on theory of similarity, similarity numbers, use for design and construction of machines.
Analytical and numerical tools for a modern approach to machine design.
Possibilities and approaches of verification of design parameters.
Long-term monitoring of the condition of machines and technical systems.
bibliography: Ruban, A.I.: Fluid Dynamics, Oxford University Press, 2017, ISBN: 9780199681754.
Turton, R.K.: Rotodynamic Pump Design, Cambridge University Press, 2005, ISBN: 0521019621
McKenzie, A.B.: Axial Flow Fans and Compressors : Aerodynamic Design and Performance, Taylor & Francis Ltd, 1997, ISBN13 9780291398505
